HeartGold & SoulSilver series · TM

HS—Triumphant

Released November 3, 2010 · 103 cards

HS—Triumphant is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the HeartGold & SoulSilver series, released in English on November 3, 2010. Its main set has 102 cards, plus 1 secret rare numbered beyond the set (103 in total). It includes 96 Pokémon, 6 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

33 illustrators worked on HS—Triumphant. Most cards: Hideaki Hakozaki (7), Ryo Ueda (7), Kagemaru Himeno (6), Kouki Saitou (5), Masakazu Fukuda (5), match (4), Mitsuhiro Arita (4), Naoyo Kimura (4).
